info.title: JobForge API
info.description: Single-person job application workspace. JSON bodies are limited to 2097152 bytes. The profile is the source of verified facts. Clients must ignore unknown response fields within API v1. Bearer tokens carry scopes described on each operation; bearer authentication is not OAuth. There is no HTTP rate limiter, batch API, or Idempotency-Key support. URL deduplication and application ids support retry reconciliation. PDF concurrency is 2 per process, with a queue bounded by 20 waiting jobs or 20 MB HTML and a 60-second wait deadline; render_failed reports busy/timeout failures.

post.summary: Dry-run an application without storing it
post.description: Requires a profile, including for skip. Skip discards supplied resume/cover. Duplicate is reported, not rejected. No persistence. Required scope: write:applications.

parameters.name: render
parameters.description: Exactly 0 skips PDFs and omits pages; otherwise render and enforce page limits.

post.summary: Prepare, render, and file one application
post.description: One vacancy per record. Non-skip requires resume; cover is optional at filing. Skip discards documents and sets status skipped; otherwise status draft. Returns 409 with error.details[0].existing_id for a normalized URL duplicate. The pipeline overrides document languages with vacancy.language, then resume language, cover language, or en. Guard errors and page overflow store nothing. Warnings do not block. Required scope: write:applications.

post.summary: Change status and append an event
post.description: Authentication is enforced in the handler. Targets draft/needs_review/skipped require write:applications; other targets require approve. Without approve, transitions are draft -> needs_review|skipped, needs_review -> draft|skipped, skipped -> draft. With approve, any source/target is allowed subject to target scope and document presence: approved/sent reject skip and require both PDFs for document-bearing records. The server does not send applications. Required scope: write:applications or approve (depends on target).

post.summary: Import into an empty data store, then attempt PDF regeneration
post.description: Token rows are allowed in an otherwise empty target. Rows restore transactionally; later PDF regeneration failures appear in render_errors without undoing the imported data. Body limit is 2 MB; use the CLI for larger bundles. Required scope: admin.

bearerAuth.description: JobForge secret token. agent: read, write:applications, write:tracks, write:templates. setup adds write:profile. owner has all seven scopes.

localized.description: String values keyed by language codes matching ^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Za-z]+)?$. The minimal validator does not enforce language keys or schema-valued additionalProperties.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token.

Error403.description: Token lacks the required scope, or resource is read-only.

Error404.description: Resource, route, file, or template version not found.

Error405.description: Method not allowed; inspect the Allow header.

Error409.description: Duplicate vacancy URL, status conflict, referenced resource, or nonempty import target.

Error422.description: Schema/fact validation, missing profile, unsupported document version, or rendering/page-limit failure.

Error500.description: Internal server failure; inspect server logs.
